title: Eisenhower's granddaughter is an abductee

tellings.quote: So if you know Eisenhower's granddaughter is an abductee and is like all over this issue

plain: Laura Eisenhower, a granddaughter of President Eisenhower, is said to be an abductee, meaning someone who says she has been taken by non-human beings, and to be deeply involved in the UFO subject. Michels mentions it in passing himself, without naming a source. He raises it as a sign of how close the subject runs to the family of a president.
